desc: Luth-AR's MBA-3 Modular Carbine Stock is designed to be compatible with both Commercial and Mil-Spec Diameter Carbine Buffer Tubes for the AR-15 and AR-10 platforms. The MBA-3 is fully adjustable, and comes equipped with a 3-axis adjustable butt plate, adjustable cheek rest and adjustable length of pull. Additional features include multiple sling mounting points and a bottom Picatinny accessory rail for use in mounting a rear monopod. The MBA-3 will fit all .223 and most .308 AR carbine style rifles. It is constructed of strong glass filled nylon, is easy to replace and quick to install. An included anti-rattle screw ensures a secure fit to either diameter carbine buffer tube.
